title: Kilagen Risk Taxonomy
description: Validates program/model/risk-taxonomy.yml — the controlled vocabulary risks are classified against, plus the scoring scales and the severity bands derived from them.
$comment: WHY THE BANDS LIVE HERE. Severity used to be parsed out of a markdown table inside a standard, which is fragile in the obvious way and silently stopped being checked. Likelihood, impact and the bands are vocabulary, exactly like the category tree — one place, validated, and the same source for the heatmap and for any severity badge. The prose in the standard stays as the human explanation of what the numbers mean.

categories.description: What kind of risk it is, as a tree. A risk's risk_category names a full path through it; the path is resolved by the reference checks, not here.

causes.description: Why it happened, grouped. A risk's root_causes name leaf slugs from any group.

severity.description: The scoring model. Severity is likelihood multiplied by impact, banded.

id.description: Must be a severity value the frontmatter schema accepts, or a risk could be banded into a severity no document may declare.

scale.description: The ordered points of one axis, lowest first. Both axes must have the same length — the matrix is square.

note.description: The plain-language reading, e.g. 'Rare' or 'Highly likely'.
